items.text:
Stats: u.gg, Ranked Solo, NA server. Raw win rates,
not adjusted for who picks what. Rune text: LoL wiki (ranged values).
Patch 26.20 (Riot's 16.20), pulled 2026-10-22.
Rank buckets overlap: Diamond+ holds the Master+ games,
and Master+ holds the Challenger games.

Win rate %. Dot = u.gg number.
Whisker = rough 95% noise from the game count alone.
Tan line = Kog'Maw's average in that sample.
g = games (pick rate × matches, rounded).

Precision · Attacks on champions stack up to 6 times, +4.8%
attack speed each (28.8% max). At 6 stacks, attacks fire a
bolt: 6 to 21.7 damage, +1% per 1% bonus AS.

Sorcery · Deal 25% of a champion's max HP within 3s: +36% move
speed and 50% slow resist for 4s. Cooldown 20 to 8.8s.

Precision · 3 hits on one champion: 40 to 174 adaptive damage,
then +8% damage to them until out of combat. Cooldown 6s.

Sorcery · Ability damage drops a comet: 15 to 110 (+10% bonus
AD, +5% AP). Cooldown 20 to 6.6s.

Inspiration · Hit a champion first: 3s of +7% bonus true
damage, then gold equal to 35% of that bonus damage. Cooldown
25 to 15s.
0.5% pick rate or less (NA All ranks). Too few games to say anything:

Dark Harvest 37.3% (124 g)
Deathfire Touch 46.67% (119 g)
Hail of Blades 51.35% (109 g)
Fleet Footwork 69.77% (42 g)
Conqueror 41.46% (40 g)
Electrocute 51.61% (30 g)
Grasp of the Undying 44.83% (30 g)
Summon Aery 60% (10 g)
Unsealed Spellbook 66.67% (10 g)

These are raw win rates. Players who pick an
off-meta rune may be one-tricks, or picking it
into a matchup that was already hard, so a gap
is a clue, not a cause.
Green or red only when the dot sits further from
the average than its whisker.

• Lethal Tempo is the default overall (75.99% of
all-rank games), but its share drops as rank
rises: 75.99% → 57.45% → 49.68% → 28.01%.
• Stormraider's Surge rises in its place: 5.55%
→ 19.89% → 28.8% → 48.43% of games, from all
ranks up to Challenger.
• From Diamond+ up it also wins more than Tempo:
+4.0 pp in Diamond+ (1.5×), +8.2 pp in Master+
(2.1×), +24.9 pp in Challenger (4.1×). Overall
it is −2.7 pp (-1.9×).
• Challenger is 378 games, likely from a handful
of players, so one-tricks can swing it. Treat
the high-rank pattern as a lead to test, not a
rule.
• PTA, Comet and First Strike have under 300
games in every high bucket. Too few to rank.

• Compare with coachless WPA, which adjusts for
pre-game win chance.
• Split by matchup: does PTA or Stormraider win
more into tanks or dive?
• Look at who the NA Challenger Kog players are
(u.gg leaderboard) and what they run.
• Re-pull on 26.21 once it has a full patch of
games.

Sources: https://u.gg/lol/champions/kogmaw/runes-table?role=adc&region=na1&patch=16_20
(+ &rank=overall | diamond_plus | master_plus | challenger)
